title: DAGR Analytics Observation Envelope v0.1
description: Product-neutral analytics observation. CANDIDATE — do not ratify until proving lanes establish field needs (Orientation §7). Unsigned and privacy-classed: an observation is never a governed-activity record (Constitution A16).

event_id.description: Stable unique id for this observation within its partition. ASCII-safe grammar: observations are sorted by event_id before hashing, and ASCII keeps that ordering identical across languages (the dagr.canonical-json.v0.1 code-point sort is exact only over the ASCII domain).

surface.description: Surface within the platform (e.g. wiki, api, mcp).

action.description: What occurred. C1 constrains this to the transport_read family.

object_ref.description: Opaque ref to the object acted on. Not a person.

transport.description: Observed transport/declaration — never inferred by fingerprinting (A3).

session_ref.description: Declared first-party session. Null when anonymous. Never fingerprinted.

actor_ref.description: Declared actor ref where one exists. Null by default. Never an inferred identity.

context.description: Bounded, non-identifying context. C1 v0.1 digest domain: ASCII property names and SCALAR values only (string | integer | boolean | null). Numbers are INTEGERS in +/-(2^53-1) — floats are rejected, which collapses the cross-language number problem (ECMAScript vs Python -0.0/1e-7/2.0) to trivial equality. Recursively nested objects/arrays are rejected. Floats may be admitted later only by a definition-versioned widening.
